messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Auth traffic anomaly detected for SSO proxy (auth-edge-1). ~18k 302 redirects in 5m, abnormal user-agent distribution. Possible misconfigured IdP redirect loop or replay attack. Link: https://ops.redwood.in/alerts/5070001234
azeem_oncall: Ack. Jumping in. Can someone grab the SSO proxy logs + recent LB access logs?
liz_handoff: I pulled the last 30m from auth-edge-1: status codes are mostly 302 -> 200 -> 302 loops for a subset of clients (x-forwarded-for clusters). Not typical.
sam_sre: Adding immediate firewall rule to block the suspicious /_auth/sso callback path for unnamed user-agent patterns. Will keep it scoped to corp edge for now.
maria_prodsec: Pinging legal and support. This may impact customers doing SSO with our hosted console. Need customer impact assessment before any broad key rotation.
azeem_oncall: Doing quick checklist: 1) rate-limit + block patterns (in progress) 2) create incident bridge 3) check recent deploys 4) verify service-account keys not leaked
incident-bot: [BRIDGE CREATED] https://meet.redwood.in/bridge/5070001234 (ace-team)
tony_support: On bridge. Seeing ~12 customer sessions with login failures; one customer reported callback errors in the last 10m. I can open a ticket/prep comms if we confirm customer-affecting.
sam_sre: Deployed targeted nginx rule:
```
location ~ /_auth/sso/callback {
  if ($http_user_agent ~* "(badbot|zabbix)" ) {
    return 403;
  }
}
```
Applied to auth-edge-1/2. Monitoring.
liz_handoff: No new deploys in the last hour. Config change from config-service at 5069998000 was a non-auth routing tweak (not related).
maria_prodsec: Can we confirm whether tokens or logs with PII were forwarded externally? I see a spike in traffic to our internal log-forwarder - @sam_sre can you check forwarder destination IPs and bucket writes?
sam_sre: Checking. Forwarder writes look normal; no new external destinations. There was a transient backlog and a retry to s3://redwood-staging-logs which is internal account. Still validating object list.
azeem_oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) keep targeted 403 rule 2) add temporary stricter TTL to SSO state cookies 3) rotate short-lived client secret for the SSO proxy (rolling) 4) notify affected customers (Tony to draft) 5) stand up coor channel for postmortem.
maria_prodsec: I want approval from Legal before any broad secret rotation that might trigger contractual notices. @legal_bot advise?
legal_bot: Notified legal on-call. If rotation is limited to our proxy client secret (no user tokens issued), treat as operational security action. Escalate if evidence of credential exfiltration into third parties.
tony_support: Drafting a targeted customer note: short checkbox describing observed callback errors and that we are mitigating, ETA 30-60m for resolution. Will not call out internal logs or keys.
azeem_oncall: Executing the rolling client-secret rotate now on dev->canary->prod with zero-downtime handshake. Script used:
```
./auth-tools rotate-client-secret --client sso-proxy --mode rolling --notify false
```
Logging outputs to ops-sre.
sam_sre: Confirmed new client secret accepted by canary. No auth failures reported for canary subset. Proceeding to prod.
liz_handoff: While rotating, I flagged the config to temporarily disable log-forwarder retries to external accounts (non-prod) to avoid accidental exposure.
maria_prodsec: We should also snapshot current logs to a secure bucket for forensic review: s3://forensics/5070001234-sso-snapshots. Sam, can you copy and lock ACLs?
sam_sre: On it. Copy started. ACL set to private, bucket logging enabled.
azeem_oncall: Monitoring traffic post-rotate. Metrics look back to baseline for 302 rates. Tony, send the customer note.
tonysupport (edited): Sent targeted update to 3 affected customers. No replies yet.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation step complete: client secret rotated and targeted blocking rules in place. Please continue monitoring for 2h.
maria_prodsec: Good. Next steps: 1) forensic log review (Sam) 2) broaden IP/UA blocklist if loops reappear (Azeem) 3) prepare optional full key rotation plan if forensic shows exfiltration (Legal + ProdSec).
sam_sre: Forensic snapshot completed at 5070001600. Starting analysis of callback payloads for potential tokens. Will update in 45m.
azeem_oncall: Handing off to night oncall @liz_handoff at 5070001760. If anything regresses, page with priority P1. Bridge will remain open for 2h for follow-ups.
liz_handoff: Ack. I will monitor and coordinate with Support for any customer escalations. Closing active paging window unless new alerts occur. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread archived (for now). Remember to file a postmortem if root cause requires cross-team follow-up."
